SELECT cm.Id, cm.FullName
FROM car_makers cm
JOIN model_list ml ON ml.Maker = cm.Id
JOIN car_names cn ON cn.Model = ml.Model
GROUP BY cm.Id, cm.FullName
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cn.Model) > 3;
FINAL SQL:
